# Controlled vocabulary

All 99 terms of ontology version 1.0.0. Use them as `Symbol`s,
e.g. `type = :Binding` or `cellular_location = [:Nucleus]`. A term is accepted wherever
its ancestor is expected, so `:NegativeCorrelation` is a valid `:RelationshipType`.

## Relationship types (`:RelationshipType`)

Used in the `type` field of `Interaction`, `Influence` and `Reaction`. `validate` checks the participants against **Expected left / right** (from `bn:expectedLeft` / `bn:expectedRight`); "any" means the ontology does not restrict them.

| Term | Label | Expected left | Expected right | Definition | See also |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `:Activation` | Activation | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity` | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity`, `PathwayModule` | A relationship where one entity increases or initiates the activity or function of another (e.g., gene, protein). | [INO_0000024](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/INO_0000024) |
| `:Association` | Association | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity`, `PathwayModule` | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity`, `PathwayModule` | A general relationship where entities are observed together in a context suggesting possible biological linkage. | [MI_0915](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_0915) |
| `:Binding` | Binding | `NodeEntity` | `NodeEntity` | A physical relationship where two or more entities interact via molecular binding (e.g., protein-protein, protein-DNA). | [GO_0005488](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005488) |
| `:Catalysis` | Catalysis | `Complex`, `Protein` | `Reaction` | A relationship where one entity, typically an enzyme, facilitates a reaction involving another entity without being consumed. | [GO_0003824](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0003824) |
| `:CoExpression` | Co-expression | `Gene`, `Rna` | `Gene`, `Rna` | A relationship where two genes or proteins are expressed under similar conditions, implying potential co-regulation. | [MI_2231](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_2231) |
| `:CoOccurence` | Co-occurrence | `Gene`, `Protein` | `Gene`, `Protein` | A relationship where two entities are repeatedly observed together across different datasets or conditions. |  |
| `:CompoundMediatedStep` | Compound-mediated step | any | any | A derived network step representing one segment of a compound-mediated biological relationship. It does not by itself assert production, binding, activation, or inhibition. |  |
| `:Decrease` | Decrease | `NodeEntity` | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity` | A relationship where one biological entity reduces, inhibits, or diminishes the activity, expression, or abundance of another. | [MI_2242](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_2242) |
| `:Degradation` | Degradation | `NodeEntity` | `NodeEntity` | A process in which a biological molecule, such as a protein, RNA, or metabolite, is broken down into simpler components, leading to loss of its original function or structure. | [GO_0044265](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0044265) |
| `:Dephosphorylation` | Dephosphorylation | `Protein` | `Protein` | The process of removing one or more phosphoric (ester or anhydride) residues from a molecule. | [GO_0016311](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0016311) |
| `:Dimerization` | Dimerization | `Protein` | `Protein` | A relationship that two proteins bind together to form a functional unit | [GO_0046983](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0046983) |
| `:Dissociation` | Dissociation | `NodeEntity` | `NodeEntity` | A relationship where entities previously bound together become separated, indicating a loss of interaction. | [INO_0000092](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/INO_0000092) |
| `:Enhancement` | Enhancement | `Gene` | `Gene` | A genetic relationship where combined mutations result in a stronger or more severe phenotype than expected. | [MI_1131](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_1131) |
| `:Expression` | Expression | `Gene`, `Rna` | `Protein` | The process in which a gene's sequence is converted into a mature gene product (protein or RNA). This includes the production of an RNA transcript and its processing, as well as translation and maturation for protein-coding genes. | [GO:0010467](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO:0010467) |
| `:Fusion` | Fusion | `Gene` | `Gene` | A relationship of a hybrid gene or gene product formed from two previously separate genes, typically due to chromosomal rearrangements such as translocations or deletions. | [SO_0000806](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000806) |
| `:Glycosylation` | Glycosylation | any | any | The covalent attachment and further modification of carbohydrate residues to a substrate molecule. | [GO_0070085](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0070085) |
| `:Increase` | Increase | `NodeEntity` | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity` | A relationship where one biological entity enhances, promotes, or elevates the activity, expression, or abundance of another. | [MI_2237](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_2237) |
| `:Indirect` | Indirect | any | any | The relationship is known to occur through one or more intermediate biological steps that are not explicitly resolved. | [MI_2286](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_2286) |
| `:Inhibition` | Inhibition | `NodeEntity` | `EdgeEntity`, `NodeEntity`, `PathwayModule` | A relationship where one entity reduces, blocks, or suppresses the activity or function of another (e.g. gene, protein). | [INO_0000124](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/INO_0000124) |
| `:Irreversible` | irreversible reaction | any | any | A reaction rate always refers to a single direction (forward or reverse) | [SBO_0000153](http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000153) |
| `:Methylation` | Methylation | any | any | The process in which a methyl group is covalently attached to a molecule. | [GO_0032259](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0032259) |
| `:MissingInteraction` | Missing interaction | any | any | An interaction expected in the reference pathway but absent, e.g. because of mutation. | [MI_0573](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_0573) |

| `:RegulateExpression` | Regulates xpression | `Gene`, `Protein`, `Rna` | `Gene` | A relationship indicating that one entity promotes or is responsible for the gene expression of another. |  |
| `:Repression` | Repression | `Protein`, `Rna` | `Gene` | A relationship where one entity negatively regulates or suppresses the gene expression of another. | [GO_0010629](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0010629) |
| `:Reversible` | reversible reaction | any | any | A reaction rate always refers to a reversible direction (forward and reverse). They can proceed in both directions. | [SBO_0000156](http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000156) |
| `:SignalCrosstalk` | Signal Crosstalk | `PathwayModule` | `PathwayModule`, `Protein` | A relationship where one signaling pathway influences another, |  |
| `:StateTransition` | State transition | any | any | A biological event in which the same biological entity changes its state without becoming a different entity. The change may involve its location or membrane orientation, conformation or molecular modification state, or functional activity. |  |
| `:SuccessiveReaction` | Successive reaction relationship | any | any | A relationship between catalytic entities whose biochemical reactions occur successively and are connected through a shared intermediate compound. |  |
| `:Suppression` | Suppression | `Gene` | `Gene` | A genetic relationship where a mutation in one gene compensates for or rescues the phenotype of a mutation in another gene. | [MI_1130](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MI_1130) |
| `:TranscriptionTo` | Transcription to | `Gene` | `Rna` | The process by which the genetic information stored in DNA is copied into a new molecule of messenger RNA (mRNA). | [GO_0009299](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0009299) |
| `:Translation` | Translation | `Rna` | `Protein` | The process by which a cell's machinery reads the genetic information on an mRNA molecule and synthesizes a protein from it. | [GO_0006412](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0006412) |
| `:Ubiquitination` | Ubiquitination | `Protein` | `Protein` | A relationship where one protein catalyzes the covalent addition of ubiquitin to another protein. | [GO_0016567](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0016567) |

## Cellular locations (`:CellularLocation`)

Used in the `cellular_location` field of node entities.

| Term | Label | Definition | See also |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:CellComponent` | Cellular Component | The location relative to cellular structures in which a gene product performs a function, either cellular compartments (such as the nucleus, mitochondrion, or extracellular space) or stable macromolecular complexes (such as a ribosome or proteasome). | [GO_0005575](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005575) |
| `:Apoptosome` | apoptosome | A multi-protein complex that forms in the cytoplasm during apoptosis and activates initiator caspases to trigger programmed cell death. | [GO_0043293](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0043293) |
| `:Autophagosome` | autophagosome | A double-membrane vesicle that encloses cytoplasmic material and organelles for delivery to lysosomes during autophagy. | [GO_0005776](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005776) |
| `:CellWall` | cell wall | a polarized stack of flattened membrane-bound cisternae, with associated vesicles, involved in modifying, sorting, and packaging proteins and lipids. It has a cis (receiving) face and a trans (shipping) face, reflecting its role in intracellular transport. | [GO_0005618](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005618) |
| `:Cytoplasm` | cytoplasm | The part of the cell contained within the entire plasma membrane, excluding the nucleus, and composed of the cytosol and all organelles except the nucleus and their contents. | [GO_0005737](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005737) |
| `:Cytoskeleton` | cytoskeleton | A structural framework within the cytoplasm that includes actin filaments, microtubules, and intermediate filaments, essential for maintaining cell shape, intracellular transport, and signal transduction. | [GO_0005856](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005856) |
| `:ERGogiIntermediateCompartment` | ER-Golgi intermediate compartment | A transient membrane-bound compartment located between the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi apparatus that facilitates protein trafficking. | [GO_0005793](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005793) |
| `:Endosome` | Endosome | A membrane-bound vesicular structure involved in the internalization and sorting of materials taken up by endocytosis, forming an intermediate compartment between the plasma membrane and lysosomes. | [GO_0005768](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005768) |
| `:ExtracellularMatrix` | Extracellular Matrix | A complex network of proteins and polysaccharides located outside the plasma membrane that provides structural support and mediates cell signaling. | [GO_0031012](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0031012) |
| `:ExtracellularVesicle` | Extracellular Vesicle | Any vesicle that is part of the extracellular region | [GO_1903561](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_1903561) |
| `:GolgiBody` | golgi apparatus, golgi body, golgi complex | the membrane-bound organelle found in eukaryotic cells, known for its role in modifying, sorting, and packaging proteins and lipids. Morphologically, it has a very distinctive and organized structure. | [GO_0005794](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005794) |
| `:LysosomalMembrane` | Lysosomal Membrane | The lipid bilayer enclosing the lysosome, containing proteins essential for substance transport and maintaining acidic conditions required for lysosomal degradation. | [GO_0005765](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005765) |
| `:Lysosome` | lysosome | the spherical, membrane-bound organelles containing hydrolytic enzymes active at low pH. They function as the digestive system of the cell, breaking down waste, macromolecules, and cellular debris. | [GO_0005764](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005764) |
| `:Mitochondria` | mitochondria | the double-membraned organelles with an outer membrane and a highly folded inner membrane forming cristae, enclosing a protein-rich matrix. Their elongated shape and internal complexity reflect their role in ATP production through aerobic respiration. | [GO_0005739](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005739) |
| `:MultivesicularBody` | multivesicular bodies | A type of late endosome characterized by internal vesicles formed by inward budding, involved in sorting membrane proteins for degradation. | [GO_0005771](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005771) |
| `:NuclearPoreComplex` | Nuclear Pore Complex | A large protein complex that spans the nuclear envelope, regulating the bidirectional transport of molecules between the nucleus and cytoplasm. | [GO_0005643](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005643) |
| `:Nucleolus` | Nucleolus | A sub-nuclear body where ribosomal RNA is synthesized and ribosome assembly begins, serving as a critical node for protein biosynthesis. | [GO_0005730](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005730) |
| `:Nucleus` | nucleus | A membrane-bounded organelle of eukaryotic cells in which chromosomes are housed and replicated. | [GO_0005634](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005634) |
| `:Peroxisome` | peroxisomes | A small, single-membrane-bound organelle containing enzymes for lipid metabolism and the detoxification of hydrogen peroxide. | [GO_0005777](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005777) |
| `:PlasmaMembrane` | plasma membrane | a dynamic, semi-permeable phospholipid bilayer containing embedded proteins and carbohydrates. It defines the cell boundary and regulates the transport of substances in and out of the cell. | [GO_0005886](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005886) |
| `:Ribosome` | ribosome | A small, non-membrane-bound macromolecular complex composed of rRNA and proteins that synthesizes proteins by translating mRNA. | [GO_0005840](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005840) |
| `:RoughER` | rough endoplasmic reticulum | A series of flattened membrane sacs studded with ribosomes, primarily responsible for the synthesis and initial folding of membrane-bound and secretory proteins. | [GO_0005791](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005791) |
| `:SmoothER` | smooth endoplasmic reticulum | An interconnected network of membrane-bound tubules lacking ribosomes, involved in lipid synthesis, detoxification, and calcium storage. | [GO_0005790](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005790) |
| `:Vacuole` | vacuole | A membrane-bound organelle prominent in plant and fungal cells, involved in storage, degradation, and maintaining turgor pressure. | [GO_0005773](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0005773) |
| `:Vesicle` | Vesicle | A small, membrane-enclosed sac within the cytoplasm, used to transport proteins, lipids, and other molecules between organelles or to the plasma membrane, playing a central role in exocytosis, endocytosis, and intracellular signaling pathways. | [GO_0031982](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0031982) |

Used in the `regions` field of `Dna` and `Gene`.

| Term | Label | Definition | See also |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:CDS` | Coding Sequence (CDS) | The portion of a gene's DNA or RNA that is translated into protein., Translated portion of exon that encodes protein. | [SO_0000316](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000316) |
| `:Enhancer` | Enhancer | A DNA sequence that increases transcription levels of a gene from a distance., Acts over distance to increase gene transcription. | [SO_0000165](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000165) |
| `:Exon` | Exon | A DNA sequence that remains in the mature RNA and may encode protein., Part of gene retained in mature RNA; may include coding or UTR. | [SO_0000147](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000147) |
| `:FivePrimeCap` | 5' Cap | Cap added to the 5′ end of mRNA for protection and translation. | [SO_0000581](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000581) |
| `:Insulator` | Insulator | A DNA element that blocks interactions between enhancers and unrelated promoters., Defines regulatory boundaries between domains. | [SO_0000627](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000627) |
| `:Intron` | Intron | A non-coding segment within a gene that is removed during RNA splicing., Non-coding DNA spliced out during mRNA processing. | [SO_0000188](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000188) |
| `:ORF` | Open Reading Frame (ORF) | A sequence of DNA that could potentially encode a protein, starting with a start codon and ending with a stop codon., Potential protein-coding frame bounded by start and stop codons. | [SO_0000236](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000236) |

| `:Promoter` | Promoter | A DNA region where RNA polymerase binds to initiate transcription., Initiates transcription by binding RNA polymerase. | [SO_0000167](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000167) |
| `:Silencer` | Silencer | A regulatory element that represses transcription of a gene., Prevents transcription of nearby gene sequences. | [SO_0000625](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000625) |
| `:Terminator` | Terminator | A DNA sequence that signals the end of transcription., Marks the end of transcription by RNA polymerase. | [SO_0000141](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000141) |
| `:UTR` | UTR | Untranslated region affecting mRNA regulation., Untranslated regions at the 5' and 3' ends of mRNA that regulate translation and stability. | [SO_0000203](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000203) |
| `:ThreePrimeUTR` | 3' UTR | 3′ region that affects stability and localization of mRNA., The 3' untranslated region downstream of the coding sequence in mRNA. | [SO_0000205](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000205) |
